title: Price Promise Terms: Windows, Accepted Sources and Excluded Sales
content:
The price promise on an order under Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment is set by the fulfilment service the
order was placed under. The window is the days after the order within which a lower advertised price is matched. The sources column states where a competing price is accepted from. The excluded column states the
sales the price match does not apply to.

| Fulfilment service | Window, days after the order | Where a competing price is accepted from | Sales the price match does not apply to |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Parcel Delivery | 15 | named local and online sellers | clearance, bundle and member-only pricing |
| Store Pickup Hold | 15 | named local and online sellers | clearance, bundle and member-only pricing |
| Threshold Delivery | 30 | named local and online sellers | clearance, bundle and member-only pricing |
| Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away | 30 | named local and online sellers | clearance, bundle and member-only pricing |
| White Glove Delivery and Installation | 30 | named local and online sellers | clearance, bundle and member-only pricing |
| Business Dock and Freight Delivery | 30 | contract price books and named sellers | clearance and bundle pricing |

## How the three columns differ across the services

The window is 15 days on the two lightest services, Standard Parcel Delivery and Store Pickup Hold, and 30 days on
the other four. The source column is the same on five services, named local and online sellers; Business Dock and
Freight Delivery accepts contract price books as well as named sellers. The excluded column is the same on five
services, clearance, bundle and member-only pricing; on Business Dock and Freight Delivery it is clearance and bundle
pricing.
